name: app-orange-banking-smartwatch-on-dark-wrist
title: Orange Banking Watch on a Dark Wrist
whatItIs: A pale grey backdrop with a dark forearm in silhouette crossing the frame and a smartwatch on the wrist showing a bank card balance with orange Send and Receive buttons.
whatItMeans: The dark arm against a light field makes the small bright screen the only focal point, showing how little UI a watch needs.
techniques: Silhouetted arm across the frame for drama
Small screen lit and highly legible
Orange as the sole action colour
bestFor: Product hero shots on a body

vocabulary.definition: A subject rendered as a dark shape against light.
A UI with one key number and few actions.
A photo of a wearable in use.
